leadParagraph: At 2:30 AM on June 4, 2026, Israeli warplanes struck four residential apartments simultaneously across Gaza City, killing nine Palestinians — including a father, mother, and three children. Only a nine-year-old girl survived the attack on her family's home. The massacre brings the documented death toll since the so-called ceasefire to at least 936.
methodology: Reported using on-scene footage from Quds News Network, casualty data from Al-Shifa Hospital via AP/LA Times, family-level breakdown from Yemen Press Agency, and verification against Reuters and The Independent. Cross-referenced with UTM's own ceasefire violation reporting and Salah Akram's ground dispatches from Gaza.
title: Four Apartments. Nine Martyrs. One Nine-Year-Old Girl Left Alive. This Is Israel's Ceasefire.
